quote: Existing retry.provider.maxRetries configurations change from SDK/request retry counts to a shared turn-wide budget that may stop early when the 90-second retry window expires.
note: The P1 merge-risk item flagged the shift to a shared turn-wide retry budget and focused on the 90-second ceiling. The maintainer accepted the shared budget, while the review left unaddressed that retries spent before a successful response could exhaust the budget for a later rate limit.
